shots.title: Ask, plan and buy
shots.label: Live sandbox · XRPL Testnet · live answers, rule-based buying · team-authored writers · no real value
shots.vo: Ask a question and set a budget. The sandbox writes answers live and uses fixed buying rules. Only policy code pays. It checks free sources, then can buy one article per round. The payment card records why it bought; Show work compares the searches with the plan confirmed here.

shots.title: Check the key; know the refund limit
shots.label: Local replay · recorded Testnet escrow · fictional writers · browser key check · no real value
shots.vo: The writer collects by publishing the article key. Check it yourself: this browser reads the create and finish from a public node and hashes the key. It matches. That proves the key reveal, not quality. This recorded refund needed the writer's signature; a real writer could refuse.

shots.title: Verify outside the app
shots.label: Published v1.1.1 Python verifier · recorded sandbox receipts · read-only XRPL Testnet checks
shots.vo: Export the receipts and check them outside the app. Our TypeScript and Python verifiers were written separately. Read the passed and skipped checks; a receipt verification result does not certify a writer's identity.

shots.vo: Three operator-run writers now hold accepted Testnet Credentials. A Permissioned Domain lists the credential issuer and type accepted for identity display. It's our attestation: not KYC, quality certification or payment permission.

shots.title: Unsigned ledger verdicts
shots.label: Recorded unsigned simulate results · Testnet + Mainnet reads · nothing signed/submitted
shots.vo: We ask rippled before signing. In recorded unsigned probes, RLUSD escrow returned no permission on Testnet and Mainnet. The matched TEST-SGD control succeeded on Testnet. Nothing was submitted. Our browser sandbox pays in Testnet XRP; TEST-SGD is a labelled stand-in, and mainnet spending remains disabled.
